name: payOverDueFee
intent: Clear the selected user's overdue fees covered by the supplied payment.
pre: A user with the supplied uid exists.
At least one loan for this user is returned, has a due date before today, and carries a positive overdue fee.
The supplied fee is at least the user's recorded overdue fee.
post: Set the user's overdue fee to zero.
For each selected loan belonging to this user that was returned, due before today and carried a positive overdue fee, set its overdue fee to zero.
difficulty_basis: Compound loan selection, payment bound and user-plus-many-loan updates.
scenarios: Payment 2 covers fee 1; user and matching returned overdue loan fees become zero.
Payment 1 below fee 5 violates explicit bound; unchanged fees are rejection behavior.
effects_audit: No refund/change result, payment record, BorrowStatus reset, suspension reset or clearing of unreturned loans inferred.
